title: Q3LOCK P-06 quantitative Gaussian weak-limit and bounded-weight transfer audit
question: Can the fixed-mesh Gaussian Fourier input in R-500 be promoted to a quantitative fixed-volume weak-convergence proof in the exact periodic sup-norm loop topology used by KP, without conflating that topology with the spatial W_t limit?
finding: For every beta,m,a>0 and even N>=4, the retained-mode and omitted-mode estimates give a uniform grid covariance error at most beta*(pi^2/48+3/(2*pi^2))/(m*N). Periodic polygonal interpolation adds at most sqrt(2*K*beta/(m*N)), where K=1/(beta*a)+beta/(12m). Arbitrary-time increments have variance below 14*d_beta/m and fourth moments of order d_beta^2, yielding fixed-volume C_per tightness and Gaussian weak convergence. A bounded residual-weight lemma then transfers the convergence to normalized finite-volume Q3LOCK loop laws under the separately stated compact Riemann-sum and quartic bounds. The verifier passes 13502/13502 assertions and two replay artifacts are byte-identical.
decision_reason: R-500 verified the finite identities but explicitly left the analytic Gaussian weak limit open. The new retained-mode estimate, Fourier-tail estimate, interpolation modulus and arbitrary-time Kolmogorov bound supply that missing fixed-volume argument with derived constants. The KP source check confirms that C_beta with the sup norm is the correct one-site loop space, while Omega_t and W_t remain separate spatial projective-limit objects.
boundary: Quantitative fixed-spatial-volume Gaussian covariance, interpolation, tightness, bounded residual-weight transfer and source-UI proof text only. External mathematical acceptance, the exact final residual split, spatial W_t accumulation, P-09/FSS, operator, pressure, cusp, DLR multiplicity, claim promotion, manuscript and PDF remain open.
next_action: Obtain an external line-by-line audit of the covariance and Kolmogorov bounds and verify the identical harmonic residual split in the final Q3LOCK theorem text; then combine the accepted fixed-volume loop input with P-06 association and P-09 without promoting the spatial W_t or phase gates.
method: Split the discrete-to-continuum covariance difference into retained modes and omitted continuum modes.
Derive the retained-mode bound from sin(x)>=2x/pi and x^2-sin^2(x)<=x^4/3, and bound the asymmetric Nyquist tail explicitly.
Use the continuum massless increment comparison to control the covariance modulus and polygonal interpolation error.
Treat arbitrary times in same or adjacent cells separately from separated cells and derive the uniform variance factor 14.
Apply the Gaussian fourth-moment formula and Kolmogorov criterion to obtain fixed-volume periodic sup-norm tightness.
Prove the bounded residual-weight transfer by a common compact/tail split and retain quartic Young uniform integrability for unbounded source witnesses.
Check the analytic constants, hostile weakened inequalities and interpolation probes across three parameter triples and five meshes, then replay twice and compare output hashes.
assumptions: The Gaussian reference action is S_G,N=(1/2)sum_k[(m/epsilon)(x_(k+1)-x_k)^2+a*epsilon*x_k^2] with beta=N*epsilon and a,m>0.
The spatial volume is fixed and finite during the time-mesh limit, so the reference is a finite product of independent scalar periodic Gaussians.
The Q3LOCK residual weights are uniformly bounded above by the quartic lower bound and their actions converge uniformly on compact equicontinuous loop sets.
The source family uses a mesh-uniform positive normalizer lower bound and the displayed quartic coercivity constant.
The KP v1 C_beta sup-norm topology is the target only for the fixed-volume loop limit; W_t is reserved for later spatial accumulation.
missing_assumptions: External mathematical acceptance of every analytic inequality and the Kolmogorov tightness passage.
A final line-by-line confirmation that the Q3LOCK finite-grid residual and continuum Feynman--Kac action use the identical harmonic split and boundary convention.
Independent acceptance of the P-06 association composition, P-09/FSS loop passage and the spatial weighted-tempered accumulation.
Completion of pressure, operator, KKK, source-tangent, bounded claim registration, clean replay, content freeze and external referee gates.

adversarial_review.check: Does pointwise convergence of each Fourier mode imply the loop weak limit?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: a uniform retained-mode error, omitted-mode tail, interpolation modulus and tightness proof are all explicit.

adversarial_review.check: Can the polygonal laws converge in total variation to the OU loop law?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: their supports are mutually singular at every finite mesh; only weak convergence is used.

adversarial_review.check: Do vertex increment estimates automatically control arbitrary interpolation times?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: same/adjacent cells and separated cells are treated separately before the factor 14 is obtained.

adversarial_review.check: Is the finite-product C_per topology the same as KP W_t?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: W_t is a spatial weighted projective-limit topology and remains a later gate.

adversarial_review.check: Does weak convergence alone pass the source exponential and second derivative?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: a quartic Young Lp bound and a mesh-uniform normalizer lower bound are required.

adversarial_review.check: Do 13502 finite assertions replace external acceptance of the analytic theorem?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: the fixtures are deterministic regression evidence only.

adversarial_review.check: Does this result close the cusp, phase or PDF gates?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: every spatial, operator, pressure, DLR, claim, referee and publication gate remains separate.

non_claims: No spatial W_t thermodynamic limit or source-varying DLR compactness is proved by the time-mesh result.
No unconditional continuous-loop FKG, FSS infrared bound, pressure cusp, phase coexistence or DLR multiplicity is certified.
No extremality, purity, clustering, KMS state, common real-time dynamics, ground-state phase, spectral gap or continuum limit follows.
No physical-vacuum, cosmological, Sector A, CP1, C6, Pre-A, Yang--Mills or mass-gap conclusion follows.
No claim-tier promotion, P2 manuscript, submission, upload, release, tag or PDF is created.
revisit_condition: Reopen if the Gaussian precision, interpolation, harmonic split, finite-volume topology, residual action or KP source version changes, or if external review finds a constant, topology or compactness defect.
